summary: Backend testing of new GET /api/pronounce endpoint. Created /app/backend/tests/test_pronounce.py with 11 tests covering CMU lookup (butter, Whitmore), case-insensitivity, LLM/none fallback for out-of-dict words, validation errors (empty, whitespace-only, punctuation-only), and regression on core endpoints. All 11 new tests pass. Full suite (62 tests including 51 pre-existing) passes with 0 failures.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~917 lines — consider splitting routers into modules (scenes, pronounce, tts) for maintainability, but not blocking.

GET /api/pronounce correctly returns 400 for empty/whitespace/punctuation, uses CMU first then Claude fallback, and gracefully returns source='none' with ipa=null when LLM is unreachable (verified indirectly — xyzzytest returned source='llm' in this run).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only against /api/pronounce and existing regression endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pronounce endpoint fully tested and stable. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_pronounce.py. Note: test_proper_nouns_and_tts_turn.py::test_legacy_scene_migrates_on_get requires MONGO_URL in shell env (reads os.environ directly); pass by sourcing backend/.env. Not a bug in the endpoint under test.
